scope: One internal pose source, six complete character combinations and static lighting/facing guides. No complete shirt animation or player recipe.

criteria.lowerProtection: Original shorts pixels at least two native pixels below the measured per-column waistline and every shoe pixel must remain unchanged. Foreground arm pixels are checked separately; a global horizontal cutoff is invalid for this bent body.
criteria.collarProtection: Every opaque original shirt pixel above native row 134 must be covered; use the inspected original cloth and source-bound material regions to distinguish cloth from bent-face eyes/skin.
criteria.scope: Declared before source paint generation; not appearance acceptance.
